versions.content: In case State is NULL or Config is NULL, the function E2E_SMCheckInit shall return immediately with E2E_E_INPUTERR_NULL. Else (i.e. both pointers arenot NULL), the function E2E_SMCheckInit shall initialize the State structure, setting: 1. ProfileStatusWindow[] to E2E_P_NOTAVAILABLE on each element of the array 2. WindowTopIndex to 0 3. OKCount to 0 4. ERRORCount to 0 5. SMState to E2E_SM_NODATA and it shall return with E2E_E_OK.
